title: Nvidia launches vision model 10x faster with parallel #nvidia #parallelboxcoding #computervision
description: Nvidia released an open source computer vision model that is up to 10 times faster than leading models. It achieves this speed by using parallel box coding, predicting entire bounding boxes at once instead of step-by-step. Trained on over 100 million queries and hundreds of millions of boxes, this model outperforms competitors like Qwen 3 VL in efficiency and speed. Its release on Hugging Face and Github supports wider adoption and faster innovation in computer vision applications. This breakthrough advances the field by enabling real-time, large-scale vision tasks with greater accuracy and computational efficiency, impacting industries from autonomous vehicles to video analytics. #Nvidia #ComputerVision #ParallelBoxCoding #OpenSourceAI #Qwen3VL #HuggingFace #Github #AIModels #MachineLearning #VisionAI #DeepLearning #ArtificialIntelligence #TechInnovation #AIResearch #AutonomousVehicles
